title: 第23章 通天灵舟第24章 仙姿阅女榜
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
“吕师兄，你先回去吧，我去找李师兄讨要几瓶养魂丹！”
说着，陈岚转身御剑远去了。
“师妹，你……”
吕韦一脸无奈的看着渐渐远去的师妹。
养魂丹对他们的确很重要。
但也不能总去麻烦李师兄吧。
外门，小竹峰。
“李师兄！”
陈岚飞身而下，娇媚的声音也传入了李蒙耳中。
李蒙笑眯眯看着好似仙女一般缓缓落地的陈师妹。
“陈师妹，你怎么又回来了？”
陈岚盈盈一笑。
步伐轻盈的小跑着来到了李蒙身旁。
蹲下身的陈岚抓住了李师兄的手臂。
“李师兄明日就要前往血色禁地了，师妹想要多陪陪你嘛！”
李蒙伸手轻抚着陈师妹那洁白滑嫩的脸庞。
“说吧，你又想要什么？”
两人本来就是利益上的交易。
李蒙自然不会在陈岚身上投入不该有的感情。
除非陈师妹的好感度达到90点。

“师兄，难道在你眼中我就是这样的女人吗？”
陈岚脸上露出了伤心之色。
那楚楚可怜的模样惹人怜惜。
李蒙伸手弹了一下陈师妹的脑门。
“说吧，要什么，师兄要是有，自然会给你。”
陈岚面露幽怨之色。
“师兄，神魂强大能够提升筑基几率，师兄给的养魂丹很好用，就是不够用！”
李蒙呵呵一笑，扬手一挥。
三瓶丹药从储物袋中飞出摆在了茶桌上。
“拿去吧，吃完了就老老实实闭关筑基去！”
陈岚大喜。
笑盈盈的朝着李师兄抛了一个&nbp;媚眼。
“李师兄，谢谢您！”
陈岚俯身在李师兄的脸颊上亲吻了一下。
纤纤细手一挥。
茶桌上的丹药被陈岚收入了储物袋。
李蒙顺势而为的抱住了陈师妹的腰身。
把陈师妹那曼妙娇躯抱入了怀中。
陈岚脸色微红，连忙用神识扫了一眼附近。
要是被吕师兄看到那可就不好了。
content_en:
"Senior Brother Lu, please go back first. I'll go to Senior Brother Li to ask for a few bottles of soul-nurturing pills!"
With that said, Chen Lan turned around and walked away with his sword.
"Junior sister, you..."
Lu Wei looked helplessly at his junior sister who was gradually walking away.
Soul nourishing pills are indeed very important to them.
But we can’t always bother Senior Brother Li.
Outer gate, Xiaozhu Peak.
"Senior Brother Li!"
Chen Lan flew down, and her charming voice reached Li Meng's ears.
Li Meng smiled and looked at Junior Sister Chen who was slowly landing on the ground like a fairy.
"Junior Sister Chen, why are you back again?"
Chen Lan smiled.
He jogged to Li Meng's side with light steps.
Chen Lan squatted down and grabbed Senior Brother Li's arm.
"Senior Brother Li is going to the Bloody Forbidden Land tomorrow. Junior Sister, I want to spend more time with you!"
Li Meng stretched out his hand to caress Junior Sister Chen's white and smooth face.
"Tell me, what do you want?"
The two of them were originally engaged in a transaction of interests.
Naturally, Li Meng would not invest any unnecessary emotion in Chen Lan.
Unless Junior Sister Chen's favorability reaches 90 points.
"Brother, am I this kind of woman in your eyes?"
Chen Lan had a sad look on his face.
That pitiful appearance arouses pity.
Li Meng reached out and flicked Junior Sister Chen's forehead.
"Tell me what you want. If senior brother has it, he will give it to you."
Chen Lan had a look of resentment on her face.
"Senior brother, a strong soul can increase the chance of foundation building. The soul nourishing pill given by senior brother is very useful, but it is not enough!"
Li Meng chuckled and waved his hand.
Three bottles of elixir flew out of the storage bag and were placed on the tea table.
"Take it, and after you finish eating, go into seclusion and build your foundation!"
Chen Lan was overjoyed.
He smiled and gave Senior Brother Li a wink.
"Senior Brother Li, thank you!"
Chen Lan leaned over and kissed Senior Brother Li on the cheek.
A slender hand waved.
The elixir on the tea table was put into the storage bag by Chen Lan.
Li Meng took advantage of the situation and hugged Junior Sister Chen's waist.
He took Junior Sister Chen's graceful body into his arms.
Chen Lan's face turned slightly red and she quickly glanced around with her spiritual consciousness.
It would be bad if Senior Brother Lu saw him.
